# Switch NX2 - read at every start of the Eglantine GUI (eden.exe). The command line
# version (eden-cli) does not read it: give it the variables in its environment.
# One NAME=VALUE per line. Lines starting with # are ignored.
# A variable already set in the environment wins over this file.
# Between files, %APPDATA%\eden\nx2_switches.txt (yours) wins over this one, so editing
# this file is never needed: copy the lines you want into your own and restart.
#
# Restart the emulator after editing.
#
# A few switches are read before this file is loaded, so only the real environment (a
# launcher .bat) sets them: EDEN_NX2_3D_METHODS, ALIAS_LAZY, PROFILE_TSC, RANGE_SKIP,
# SAME_SKIP, SMALL_WRITE, SSBO_MEMO, SYNC_EXACT, SYNC_SKIP, TEX_TOUCH_SKIP, and the
# pusher's EDEN_NX2_PB_CHECK and SEM_WATCH (all EDEN_NX2_...).
